title: MedSAM
core_mech: 在 SAM 提示式架构上以大规模多模态医学分割监督做领域适配，并将 box prompt 作为稳定的目标定位接口。
core_mech_en: Adapts the promptable SAM architecture across 1.57 million medical image–mask pairs spanning 10 imaging modalities using bounding-box prompts.
input_desc: 标准化二维医学图像与目标边界框
input_en: Normalized 2D medical image slice + target anatomical/lesion bounding box prompt
output_desc: 边界框条件下的医学目标分割 mask
output_en: Box-conditioned binary segmentation mask for the target medical structure

adapter.name: MedSAM
adapter.mechanism: Original MedSAM image/prompt/mask modules, box-only prompts, frozen prompt encoder, and author squared-prediction Dice plus BCE training objective.
limitations: Unmodified Apache-2.0 MedSAM architecture at reduced dimensions. Random initialization replaces SAM/MedSAM checkpoints; this is the fine-tuning mechanism on synthetic data, not a pretrained medical model.

The original MedSAM [0,1] input convention is retained. Synthetic grayscale is repeated into RGB; supplied tight boxes replace the original randomly perturbed training boxes and medical preprocessing.
The prompt encoder stays frozen as in the author training script. IoU scores are returned for inspection but are not trained by MedSAM's Dice+BCE objective. No clinical data or performance claim.
